use_case_name: Enter and Validate a Treatment Claim

claims.content: To enter a treatment claim into the system and validate it manually and through the system, rejecting claims with missed mandatory information or false information back to the VSP and keeping them in a quarantine area.

goal.raw_text: To enter a treatment claim into the system and validate it manually and through the system, rejecting claims with missed mandatory information or false information back to the VSP and keeping them in a quarantine area.

claims.content: MSIU Field Office User
The VSP has collected the claim forms and submitted the Claim (Treatment Form) to the MSIU Field office according to the payment terms (Bi-monthly / Monthly) mentioned in the VSP master.
The service (treatment) has occurred at the VSP (Service Provider) clinic or hospital, and the attending doctor has filled the claims form.

On completion of the service, the patient has provided the voucher according to the visit type and patient type (client or partner), the voucher is stuck to the claim form, and the thumb print has been placed on completion of the service.
A manual claim form is available from which the information must be entered exactly into the system.
The VSP submits the Claim (Treatment Form) to the MSIU Field Office according to the payment terms (Bi-monthly / Monthly) mentioned in the VSP master.

trigger.raw_text: The VSP submits the Claim (Treatment Form) to the MSIU Field Office according to the payment terms (Bi-monthly / Monthly) mentioned in the VSP master.

claims.content: The MSIU Field Office User processes the Claim (Treatment Form) submitted by the VSP to the MSIU Field office according to the payment terms (Bi-monthly / Monthly) mentioned in the VSP master.
The MSIU Field Office User selects the Treatment Form No from Claim receipt details which all are not yet entered in claim.
The system interfaces with the bar-code reader to verify voucher number, claim form entry and selection of voucher usage by the clients.
The system interfaces with the thumb-print reader for verifying the claims form used by the clients.
The MSIU Field Office User enters the claim information exactly into the system from the manual claim form.
The system provides the provision to enter any number of Syndrome, Clinical Examinations, Diagnosis, Lab Test, Drugs and Other Measures in any treatment level based on MSIU treatment master.
The MSIU Field Office User validates the claim form manually and through the system.

The system validates every information during claim entry, with all above master level information mandatory other than Contact No, and the system only accepts claims if the mandatory information is complete.
The MSIU Field Office User enters the validated claim into the database.
If any mandatory information is missed or any false information exists, the field office rejects the claim back to the VSP and the system keeps the claim in a quarantine area.
The quarantined forms are sent back to the VSP for verification.
If the VSP returns the claim with satisfactory details, the claims are entered on to the system in the following month’s batch.

If any mandatory information is missed or any false information exists, the field office rejects the claim back to the VSP and the system keeps the claim in a quarantine area. Exit: the quarantined form is sent back to the VSP for verification.
If the VSP returns the claim with satisfactory details, the claim is entered on to the system in the following month’s batch. Exit: the claim is entered in the following month’s batch.
If mandatory information is incomplete, the system does not accept the claim. Exit: the claim is rejected back to the VSP and kept in the quarantine area.
The claim form has been validated manually and through the system.
All master level information other than Contact No is complete for the claim.
The system has accepted the claim only if the mandatory information is complete.
For a quarantined claim returned by the VSP with satisfactory details, the claim has been entered on to the system in the following month's batch.
